# $f_4$ test of gene flow

```{r}
library(slendr)
init_env()

library(dplyr)   # manipulating tabular data
library(ggplot2) # data visualization
library(cowplot) # composing plots into panels
library(purrr)   # convenient looping functions
```

```{r}
simulate_f4 <- function(model, W, X, Y, Z, nreps, mode = "branch") {
  schedule_list <- lapply(
    c(W, X, Y, Z),
    function(x) schedule_sampling(model, times = 0, list(model$populations[[x]], 10))
  )
  schedule <- do.call(rbind, schedule_list)

  replicates <- seq_len(nreps)

  f4_list <- lapply(replicates, function(rep_i) {
    ts <- msprime(model, sequence_length = 20e6, recombination_rate = 1e-8, schedule = schedule)
    samples <- ts_names(ts, split = "pop")
    ts_f4(ts, W = samples[W], X = samples[X], Y = samples[Y], Z = samples[Z], mode = mode)
  })

  f4 <- do.call(rbind, f4_list)
  f4$statistic <- paste0("f4(", paste(W, X, Y, Z, sep = ","), ")")
  f4$rep <- replicates

  f4
}
```

```{r}
p1 <- population("p1", time = 4000, N = 1000)
p2 <- population("p2", time = 3000, N = 1000, parent = p1)
p3 <- population("p3", time = 2000, N = 1000, parent = p2)
p4 <- population("p4", time = 1000, N = 1000, parent = p3)

model <- compile_model(list(p1, p2, p3, p4), generation_time = 1)

plot_model(model)
```

```{r}
scenarios <- rbind(
  simulate_f4(model, W = "p4", X = "p3", Y = "p2", Z = "p1", nreps = 20),
  simulate_f4(model, W = "p4", X = "p1", Y = "p3", Z = "p2", nreps = 20),
  simulate_f4(model, W = "p4", X = "p2", Y = "p4", Z = "p1", nreps = 20)
)
```


```{r}
plot_grid(

plot_model(model),

ggplot(scenarios, aes(statistic, f4)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red"),

nrow = 2

)
```
